title: 第476章 镇世金身诀第475章 竞争
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
刹那之间。
足以融化一件顶级圣器的恐怖高温消散，取而代之的是深入骨髓的极致寒气！
如同天地变换，从最炎热的夏天切来到了酷寒深冬。
“果然如我所料！”
“这寒气......比炙热的熔岩还要恐怖得多！”
“真正的考验才刚刚开始！”
凌川站在玄冰层边缘，低头看向熔岩与冰层的交界地。
其实从严格意义上来说，两者并不是完全泾渭分明。
玄冰层边缘实际上向熔岩区域那边蔓延了大约半寸的距离。
凌川抬头看向前方，四百丈之外便是湖中心，那里有一株红蓝两色的莲花在风中轻轻摇曳。
“最后的四百丈......冰火两仪莲非我莫属！”
他极为自信，嘴角带着淡淡的笑容。
不过这停留的几息时间内，对面的申屠狂已经走出了十几丈的距离。
“申屠狂果然名不虚传，我等难以度过的岩浆，他竟没有受到一丝阻碍！”
“还有那个人也不简单，与申屠狂表现无二！”
“话说，你们觉得申屠狂与那个人谁能胜出？”
岸上众人开始讨论最终的结果。
......
方圆四百丈的玄冰层，越往里寒气愈发恐怖，千丝万缕，直往毛孔里钻。
甚至，寒气还不是最重要的。

当生灵在冰层上前进时，穿着的战靴仿佛不存在，像是直接赤脚踩在冰层上，一股股惊人的寒意直接传递到身体中，连体内气血都要冻住！
不过，目前对于凌川来说，还不算什么。
他信步走在玄冰层上，体内气血在经脉中奔涌，隆隆作响，传递出惊人的热量，整个人如同一尊炽盛的熔炉！
“咦......那人......”
凌川加快速度，寒气刚一触体，立刻消散。
在他前方三十丈处，一名人族青年浑身结冰，整个人一动不动，仿佛成为了一座冰雕，气息更是微不可察，似乎已经完全寂灭！
“不会真的冻死了吧？”
凌川眉头微皱，来到此人身旁，手掌搭在此人肩上。
下一刻，他眼眉一跳，似意外又不意外。
“还有救。”
轰隆！
凌川体内发出一声暴鸣，一股磅礴的气血顺着手掌灌注到此人身躯中。
简单做完这一切后，他收回手掌，继续前行。
“太好了！师兄得救了！”岸上，一名青年原本因过度担忧而苍白的脸上，露出无尽的感激之色。
......
content_en:
In an instant.
The terrifying high temperature that could melt a top-level holy weapon dissipated and was replaced by the extreme cold that penetrated into the bone marrow!
Just like the change of heaven and earth, from the hottest summer to the coldest winter.
"It's just as I expected!"
"This cold air... is much more terrifying than the hot lava!"
"The real test has just begun!"
Lingchuan stood on the edge of the black ice layer, looking down at the junction of lava and ice.
In fact, strictly speaking, the two are not completely distinct.
The edge of the black ice layer actually spreads about half an inch toward the lava area.
Lingchuan looked up and looked ahead. Four hundred feet away was the center of the lake, where a red and blue lotus flower was swaying gently in the wind.
"The last four hundred feet...the ice and fire lotus belong to me!"
He was extremely confident, with a faint smile on his lips.
However, in the few breaths that he stayed there, Shentu Kuang on the opposite side had already walked more than ten feet away.
"Shen Tu Kuang is indeed well-deserved for his reputation. He didn't even encounter any hindrance from the magma that was so difficult for us to survive!"
"And that person is not simple either. He behaves the same as Shen Tu Kuang!"
"Speaking of which, who do you think will win between Shentu Kuang and that person?"
Everyone on the shore began to discuss the final result.
...
There is a layer of black ice with a radius of 400 feet, and the cold air becomes more and more terrifying as it goes deeper, with thousands of threads going straight into the pores.
Even the cold is not the most important thing.
When the creatures are advancing on the ice, the combat boots they are wearing seem to be non-existent. It is like stepping directly on the ice with bare feet. Shocking chills are directly transmitted to the body, and even the qi and blood in the body are frozen!
However, for Lingchuan, it is nothing at present.
He walked leisurely on the black ice layer, the energy and blood in his body rushed through the meridians, rumbling, transmitting amazing heat, the whole person was like a blazing furnace!
"Hey... that person..."
Lingchuan speeded up, and the cold air dissipated as soon as it touched his body.
Thirty feet in front of him, a human youth was covered in ice. He was motionless, as if he had become an ice sculpture. His breath was even more imperceptible, and he seemed to have been completely extinguished!
"You won't really freeze to death, will you?"
Lingchuan frowned slightly, came to this person's side, and put his palm on his shoulder.
The next moment, his eyebrows jumped, which seemed unexpected but not surprising.
"There is still hope."
Boom!
Lingchuan's body let out a roar, and a majestic energy and blood poured into this person's body along the palm of his hand.
After simply doing all this, he retracted his palm and continued to move forward.
"Great! Senior brother is saved!" On the shore, a young man's face, which was originally pale due to excessive worry, showed endless gratitude.
...
